subject: Vendr profile: evidence TTL mapping & handback choreography
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@brightleaf.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr profile TTL mapping + request for handback flow

Hi Rafael / Marissa,

Quick intro — I'm Alex on Brightleaf's security team. We're finishing a vendor inventory review and need to confirm the retention/TTL expectations for the evidence currently stored on Vendr for Redwood's profile. Two quick asks: 

1) Can you share the canonical TTL per-evidence-type (e.g., SOC2 reports, key screenshots, SSO proof) that Redwood expects Vendr to enforce when handing evidence back to customers or partners?
2) We need a machine-readable manifest that maps evidence items to their current custody and suggested retention so we can automate archival from our side.

If possible please provide the manifest as a CSV or JSON. Also curious whether you support an S3/SFTP transfer endpoint for full handback or if you prefer providing signed manifests for customer-managed retrieval.

Appreciate a short note or a 30-min sync if that's easier.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Security Engineer | Brightleaf
security@brightleaf.com

Attachments: none
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.com
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@brightleaf.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile TTL mapping + request for handback flow

Alex — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front and a proposed next step: 

- Canonical TTL: our current default is 365 days for transient artifacts (screenshots, ephemeral proofs), 730 days for formal reports (SOC 2, CAIQ PDF exports), and 1095 days for contractual evidence we retain for audit purposes. We can make exceptions by agreement.
- Manifest: attached is a first-pass CSV (vendr-evidence-manifest.csv) that maps evidence_id, type, current_location, created_at, suggested_ttl_days, and transfer_method. This should be easy to consume for automation.
- Transfer options: we support two patterns — (A) signed manifest + pre-signed S3 upload (preferred for bulk handbacks), or (B) secure SFTP push from our side to a customer-managed endpoint. Both are supported; S3 presigned is quicker for one-offs.

Proposed next step: Marissa can own the handback choreography and confirm whether Brightleaf prefers S3 presigned or SFTP. If you want, we can schedule a 30-min operational walkthrough Wednesday (9/22) afternoon.

I've cc'd Ben for any billing/contract notes around extended retention.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

Attachment: vendr-evidence-manifest.csv (CSV; 42 rows)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@brightleaf.com>, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendr profile TTL mapping + request for handback flow

Thanks Alex — quick plan from our side: 

1) Handback modes: we'll offer the S3 pre-signed bundle as the default. For customers that require inbound collection, we can do SFTP.
2) TTL defaults (confirming Rafael): transient artifacts = 365d, formal reports = 730d, contractual evidence = 1095d. We'll include a TTL header on each manifest line for clarity.
3) Operational choreography: 
   - Step A: Brightleaf confirms desired transfer method and a preferred contact for S3 presigned token delivery.
   - Step B: We run a manifest generation + checksum and upload to a holding S3 for 72 hours with a presigned URL.
   - Step C: Brightleaf retrieves bundle; we mark custody change in Vendr and attach evidence-handback-playbook.pdf to the profile with handoff notes.

I attached our internal playbook (evidence-handback-playbook.pdf) which has the S3 presigned template, field definitions for the manifest CSV, and the verification checklist (md5 + row counts).

If that works, Alex — can you confirm whether you want the S3 presigned flow and who will be your retrieval contact? Also flag any legal retention constraints — we'll create a short addendum if Brightleaf needs longer custody than our defaults.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Security Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: evidence-handback-playbook.pdf (PDF; 12 pages)
